# Reakce na odpověď

`happy.png`: veselý výraz pro správnou trojici.
`frowning.png`: zamračený výraz při chybě nebo odpovědi „Nevím“.

Vygenerováno vestavěným imagegen 2026-10-07 na výslovné přání uživatele z jím dodané fotografie. Originální fotografie není součástí repozitáře. Oba PNG zachovávají průhledné pozadí.

Použitý prompt (obě varianty):

> Use case: identity-preserve and background-extraction. Edit the attached photograph of the child to create a small website quiz feedback portrait asset. Crop to ONLY the child's head, complete hair silhouette, neck and a tiny bit of the original blue/purple collar. Preserve the child's identity, age, face proportions, hair color, hairstyle and likeness from this exact photograph. Keep photorealistic natural appearance, with gently cleaned-up lighting and clarity appropriate for the source; do not invent a different child or change age. Frontal three-quarter orientation matching the source. Center the isolated head in a square canvas, head occupying about 85 percent of image height. Fully transparent background with clean edges, no scene, no stairs, no mop, no hands, no body, no text, no border, no decorative elements.

Happy expression:

> happy and pleased, a clear natural cheerful smile, friendly eyes, subtle raised cheeks

Frowning expression:

> mildly disappointed and frowning, clearly lowered mouth corners and gently knitted eyebrows, an encouraging playful frown, no tears and no distress
